correct_source_binding_verdict: REVIEW for every alternate same-app different-activity reference; PASS only for verified immutable exact self reference in this sample, not a blanket GUI acceptance
review_limitations: The original RIGHT GUI screens are author-filtered negatives, not independently human adjudicated; a clean screen from different Activity must not be used as a valid immutable source match.

352 comparisons are correlated repetitions of 137 original clean screen pairs from 28 apps, with at most 3 different other Activities per original case. These are not 352 independent application samples.
Author bbox coordinates in 8 available annotated cases extend beyond actual rendered native PNG, so those bboxes cannot be used as exact pixel localization truth without an author-documented map.

The published RotBench natural 100 developer-confirmed bug set was not available as raw matched labelled media in this project; author-reported RotVL model scores are not local inference or our measured performance.
No independent human judgments on native Android interaction, no genuinely changing same Activity captures, no owner warehouse final photorealism and no time-coded natural video fault/clean gold.
SWAAG InspectImageTool default disabled and existing conservative policy not proven in a live tool call; this study measures off-line CPU pixels only.
